lobby.title: Imposter Arcade
lobby.subtitle: Find the imposter among us!
lobby.name: Name
lobby.wordPairsHelp: Enter word pairs separated by commas (e.g. cat/dog, sun/moon)
lobby.modeClassicDesc: Players take turns making statements. Vote to find the imposter.
lobby.modeHardcoreDesc: No discussion phase. Vote immediately after statements.
lobby.rule1: Each player receives a secret word. The imposter gets a different word.
lobby.rule2: Take turns making a statement about your word without revealing it.
lobby.rule3: After all statements, vote for who you think the imposter is.
lobby.rule4: The imposter wins if they guess the civilians' word or avoid being voted out.
lobby.nameMinError: Name must be at least {{min}} characters
lobby.nameMaxError: Name must be at most {{max}} characters
